about: Brand colors from the product spec. ios/Sublette/Core/DesignSystem/BrandColors.swift is tested against this file. Contrast ratios are checked against the WCAG 4.5:1 minimum for body text.

roles.yellow: Renter mode accent, strong-match pins, highlights
roles.magenta: Primary buttons, the like action, the match moment
roles.orange: Lister mode accent, notifications, secondary buttons
roles.ink: Body text, icons, dark mode background

text_pairs_forbidden.why: 3.5:1, matters for dark mode in phase 9
